findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "x402-service-search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_paid_data_products, best_service_for_task, economy, economy_protocols, economy_search · Private data: list_paid_data_products · Public sink: list_paid_data_products, best_service_for_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_paid_data_products, best_service_for_task, economy, economy_protocols, economy_search · Private data: list_paid_data_products · Public sink: list_paid_data_products, best_service_for_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
